Name: Rezeph
ModernLocation: Unknown; candidates include Resafa and Resappa
Description: Rezeph was a city named by the Assyrian Rabshakeh's taunt, listed among the cities whose gods had not delivered them from the king of Assyria.
BiblicalSignificance: Rezeph stands in Scripture as one of the conquered cities held up to Jerusalem as proof of Assyria's power, before Hezekiah's deliverance.
